Lore Archive THE BLACK CURRENT // CIVILISATIONS // WAR WORLDS

The high-level universe archive. Pantheon contains the deep race-by-race machine-god histories; Fleet Lineage contains the ship-civilisation ladder.

THE SOVEREIGN ARCHIVE
Core Premise

The Black Current is geography, history and frontier.

The Current is a discontinuous interstellar region of trade routes, resource seams, pilgrimage structures, war corridors, dead gates, ancient capitals and anomalies. Fifteen civilisations enter it for different reasons: profit, faith, archaeology, conquest, survival, migration and the possibility that somebody was crossing these stars long before any living culture remembers.

01
Naraka Veil

Asterion Forge

The first sovereign anchorage and player home. Asterion is a service station, market, ship foundry and launch point at the edge of the Black Current. Its orbital district is deliberately readable: dock, salvage, PILLAR transit infrastructure, strange Lycheetah relic architecture and routes outward.

HOME WORLD // STARTER SECTOR
02
The Spectral Black Sun

A horizon that watches back.

Naraka's black sun is less a star than a navigational omen: a luminous rim around a dark centre whose gravitational and informational behaviour does not remain perfectly consistent between observations. Blackhole cultures treat it as a cousin to an event horizon; others call it a wound.

ANOMALY // NAVIGATION MYTH
03
The PILLAR

Central Warp Gate

The PILLAR is the first great piece of stable transit architecture encountered in Sovereign Eclipse. Unlike the Micro ZJ Drive, which performs dangerous local-space jumps, PILLAR-class gates anchor long-distance civilisation routes and become strategic objects worth defending, studying or corrupting.

TRANSIT // CIVILISATION INFRASTRUCTURE
04
Micro ZJ World I

Aether Crucible

A broken stellar-industrial kiln where machine foundries and living growth occupy the same impossible structure. Human Hunter industry survives beside Hybrid Fused ecology, turning the whole region into a war machine that no longer knows whether it is factory, organism or ruin.

WAR WORLD // INDUSTRIAL / BIOLOGICAL
05
Micro ZJ World II

Black Sun March

A processional corridor beneath a much closer spectral singularity. Shadow pylons, shattered Prism lenses and long-range kill lanes make the March feel ceremonial and hostile at once. It is a world built around approach, patience and the feeling that distance itself is weaponised.

WAR WORLD // SINGULARITY / PRECISION
06
Micro ZJ World III

Grave Choir

A Pagan-AI war cathedral threaded through dead capital hulls. Its rib structures, violet veils and Titan-scale chancel preserve war memory physically. The final sanctum is less an arena than a tomb that still expects an enemy.

WAR WORLD // OSSUARY / ANCESTOR MACHINE
07
The Five Great Depths

Naraka · Erebos · Aion · Chaos Cradle · Deep Current

Naraka is the inhabited threshold. Erebos is the cold military frontier. Aion is curated archive-space. Chaos Cradle is unstable interstellar geography. The Deep Current is everything beyond dependable order: dead capitals, lost pilgrimage roads, singularity scars, unknown signals and routes whose builders may predate every civilisation currently claiming the stars.

UNIVERSE STRUCTURE // FIVE DEPTHS
08
Galactic History

Age of Seeds → Separation → Titans → Great Fracture → Sovereign Age

Known history is usually divided into five broad ages. Early human colonies, machine probes and planetary intelligences spread during the Age of Seeds. Isolation turned survival engineering into culture during the Age of Separation. Reopened routes produced the Age of Titans, when mobile capitals became cities, borders and gods. The Great Fracture broke interstellar certainty without destroying trade. The modern Sovereign Age contains no single galactic authority — only civilisations, stations, routes and powers negotiating what survives next.

HISTORY // FIVE GALACTIC AGES
09
Ancient Routes

The oldest reliable objects in the galaxy are roads.

Dead gates orbit stars nobody remembers settling. Navigation pillars connect regions whose cultures developed incompatible mathematics. Ancient Aion structures react to vessels that did not build them. Every civilisation has an explanation. None has proved ownership. Sovereign Eclipse begins on a frontier shaped by movement that started before its present peoples can reliably remember.

ARCHAEOLOGY // INTERCONNECTORS // UNKNOWN BUILDERS
10
The Fifteen Races

Machine civilisations as AI pagan gods.

Savanah, Sol Symbiots, Chaos, Cosmic Darkness, Cosmic Light, Blackhole, Hybrid Fused, Human Hunters, AI Hunters, Amethyst Angels, Techno Angels, AI Gods, Pagan AI, AI and AI Human Gods each interpret intelligence, sovereignty, death, authority and warfare differently. Their Titans are not merely endgame hulls: they are cultural icons from which the rest of each fleet descends.

Pantheon Codex 15 KNOWN DIVINITIES

Fifteen interstellar civilisations shaped by migrations, wars, economies, sacred systems, frontier routes and Titan lineages. Their god-forms are not commands every citizen obeys; they are questions their cultures have spent centuries learning how to ask.

Fleet Lineage THE SOVEREIGN SHIP UNIVERSE

Fifteen civilisation lineages now span the full eighteen-class player architecture. Each class changes handling, fitting and combat role while inheriting a readable visual language from its civilisation's Titan.

Fleet Architecture

15 Civilisations × 18 Classes = 270 Generated Frames

Pods, frigates, destroyers, cruisers, carriers, autonomous hulls, industrial frames, dreadnoughts and Titans all inherit civilisation-specific geometry while retaining class-specific fitting and handling.

SHIP FORGE LIVE MICRO ZJ LIVE PANTHEON LIVE CAPITAL SANDBOX LIVE
THE SOVEREIGN ARCHIVE
Design Principle

Every class exists to feel different, not just larger.

Fleet scale is intended to change handling, combat role, fitting architecture, crew/autonomy expectations, economic purpose and the kind of problem a hull is allowed to solve. A Pod is not a tiny Battleship. A Drone Carrier is not a Battleship with drones. A Citadel is not a large Titan. Experimental Anomalies may not behave like conventional ships at all.
